about: Pose prompts for Dela, the player's archer. {pose} in the base is replaced by a pose's text. Every pose takes her standing image (art/source/dela-stand.jpg) as its one reference. A bow attacks with a shot: ready (raising the bow), wind-up (full draw), slash (the loose), follow-through, recover (reaching for the next arrow). The arrow in flight is drawn in code.
base: The exact same character as the reference: same face, black bob haircut with one white feather, rose pink and white light leather armour, a short white hooded cloak, a blue sash at her waist, a quiver of arrows on her back, a wooden longbow, same colours, same art style, same size in frame. Three-quarter side view facing right. Pose: {pose}. She holds exactly one bow and at most one arrow in her hands: no second bow, no afterimage, no ghost or blurred copies. A single sharp still frame: no motion blur, no speed lines, no smear, no sparks or effects. Whole figure in frame with margin around it, bow included, even studio lighting, no cast shadow. Plain flat pure green background (#00FF00), no green on the character, no text, no ground.

ready.pose: raising the bow toward her target, an arrow nocked, beginning to draw the string back, weight settling onto her back foot

wind-up.pose: at full draw: the bowstring pulled all the way back to her cheek, the arrow aimed straight ahead, her bow arm fully extended, body steady and focused; drawn smaller in the frame so that her whole body fits, from the top of the bow down to her boots, with empty space below her feet

slash.pose: the instant after releasing the arrow: her string hand flung back past her ear with the fingers open, her bow arm still extended forward, no arrow on the bow, the string straight

follow-through.pose: holding the follow-through after the shot: the bow still raised forward, her string hand resting back by her shoulder, watching the arrow fly, no arrow on the bow; drawn smaller in the frame so that her whole body fits, from the top of the bow down to her boots, with empty space below her feet

recover.pose: lowering the bow and reaching back over her shoulder to the quiver on her back for the next arrow

run.pose: running to the right mid-stride, one foot off the ground, the bow held low in her left hand, no arrow nocked, cloak trailing behind

run-2.pose: running to the right in the passing position: one leg swinging past the other, both feet close to the ground, the bow held low in her left hand, no arrow nocked, cloak trailing behind

hurt.pose: recoiling backward from a hit, head turned away, eyes shut in pain, one arm raised, the bow lowered in the other hand, staggering

fallen.pose: fallen to one knee, slumped forward with her head down, defeated, the bow lying on the ground beside her

victory.pose: standing tall in triumph, the bow raised high above her head in her left hand, her right fist clenched, a confident smile; drawn so that everything fits, from the top of the raised bow down to her boots
